title: PR #19: fix(ci): isolate migrated Cargo crates from parent workspace
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Follow-up CI hardening after the ecosystem migration. The migrated A-TownChain algorithm and SDK manifests are standalone crates but sit below a parent Cargo tree. Adding explicit [workspace] boundaries prevents Cargo from treating them as members of an unrelated ancestor workspace and removes the workspace-membership failure mode seen in the ecosystem audit.

This change is limited to the two affected manifests and does not alter protocol logic.
